message: Independently reconstruct the harder crane courtyard using Aperture. INITIAL TURN READ-ONLY: inspect the allowed reference images/brief and your engine APIs, then report readiness and intended files. No writes, tests, renders, servers or descendants until a separate bounded permit. Correlation: 74c0770bff2a02e43372ea4dce342f86bfd81c60cafcaa2c801ba1cc43203e8c. Repo /workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-recovery-20261002; read AGENTS.md. Read only author-brief.md, scene-manifest.json and reference-front-quarter.png, reference-rear-quarter.png, reference-high-oblique.png under benchmarks/crane-reference-20261003. These are the equal frozen inputs from packet SHA256 e8b1fa929dd6fc61de28137e8aec8a8077544b19cf8f5ab899f2373bfe99039a. Do not inspect the reference builder, Blender/GLB, audits, earlier attempts or other author output; do not contact another author. Follow the shared numeric geometry, cameras, materials and seven edit constraints. Genuine editable procedural geometry only, no reference textures or imported models. Aperture source is the bytes published at4b70faeff01a75348193ae542be33b82dd69f164; three.js control is pinned vendored shadow-lab/src/compare/three.webgpu.js and three.core.js (actual REVISION185dev). Engine source read-only. Aperture must use app/ECS and native geometry; three.js must use WebGPURenderer with WebGL fallback disabled. Equal budgets: one initial source submission plus one revision after your own render, at most12 retained render attempts each including failures, same inherited model and xhigh effort. Exact model identity/full author transcript export are unavailable, so exploratory only and no scores. Later exclusive output: benchmarks/crane-comparison-20261003/author-a/v1. Provide minimal HTML/scene/worker modules ready for parent serving and captures. Use view=front-quarter|rear-quarter|high-oblique and edit=baseline|shoulder|elbow|hoist|arch|pipe|tier|assembly; reset each edit from baseline. __CRANE_READY__ must appear only after a submitted native frame and report ok:true, dimensions and scene state; keep progress separate. Expose exact native mesh vertex/transform data or reproducible CPU scene construction for independent checks, not only self-reported bounds. Parent alone handles all browser rendering through the approved lifecycle/runner and publication. Report useful results right away, before scratch notes. If work remains, use collaboration.send_message; otherwise return the result. Keep your status report short; complete the research and deliverable at the depth the task requires. If authorization is missing, or the reviewer denies an action for that reason, pause and report the exact action, target, and blocker to me. If I send <transcript_evidence> that authorizes that action and target, proceed; if already denied, retry the same tool call once. Don’t add the evidence to tool arguments. If the evidence is insufficient or the retry is denied, stop and report back. If you delegate that action, forward the block unchanged.
